mandate_description: Provides direct income transfer of Rs 6,000 per year to eligible farmer families across India.
Issues soil health cards and nutrient advisories to optimize fertilizer use and farm productivity.
Comprehensive insurance coverage against crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks.
Incentivizes states to enhance public investment in agriculture and allied infrastructure.
Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market.
Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment per financial year to every rural household.
Assistance for constructing pucca houses with basic amenities for rural families below poverty line.
Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations in rural areas.
Mobilizes rural poor households into self-managed Self Help Groups (SHGs) and supports livelihoods.
Overarching programme for school education from pre-school to senior secondary levels.
Nutritious cooked mid-day meal to improve enrollment, retention, and nutritional status of children.
Unifies all efforts related to digital/online/on-air education to enable multi-mode access.
Strengthens public healthcare systems, maternal/child health, and communicable/non-communicable disease control.
Provides health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Offers subsidized or free dialysis services to patients below poverty line at district hospital levels.
Intensive vaccination drive targeting unvaccinated or partially vaccinated children and pregnant mothers.
Provides supplementary nutrition, preschool education, and health check-ups through Anganwadi centers.
Prevents gender-biased sex selection and ensures survival, protection, and education of the girl child.
Multi-ministerial convergence mission to reduce stunting, undernutrition, anemia, and low birth weight.
